plan_name.quote: Moda Health Plan, Inc.: PEBB – Coordinated Care Full Time Plan Coverage for: Individual + Family | Plan Type: PPO CCM

deductible_family_rule.quote: If you have other family members on the plan, each family member must meet their own individual deductible until the total amount of deductible expenses paid by all family members meets the overall family deductible.

services_before_deductible.quote: Yes. Examples of some services: In-network office visits for the first four primary care, specialist and urgent care, virtual care visits, preventive care, office visits for outpatient behavioral health services, outpatient diagnostic tests, chronic condition visits, and diabetes services, maternity professional services, nutritional therapy, breastfeeding support, as well as in and out of network hospice care, routine nursery care, diabetic supplies, and breastfeeding supplies are covered before you meet your deductible.

primary_care.quote: $10 copay/visits; deductible does not apply to first 4 visits

imaging.quote: $100 copay/per service $100 copay/per service, then 30% coinsurance

urgent_care.quote: $25 copay/office visit, No charge/CirrusMD virtual visit $25 copay/office visit

inpatient_facility.quote: $50 copay per day / $250 copay per admission $500 copay per admission then 40% coinsurance

mental_health_inpatient.quote: $50 copay per day / $250 copay per admission No charge for substance use disorder $500 copay and 40% coinsurance for inpatient mental health services, 40% coinsurance for other services

pregnancy_office_visits.quote: No charge 30% coinsurance Cost sharing does not apply for preventive services. Depending on the type of services, a copay, coinsurance or deductible may apply. Maternity care may include tests and services described elsewhere in the SBC (i.e., ultrasound).

childbirth_facility.quote: $50 copay per day / $250 copay per admission $500 copay per admission then 40% coinsurance

home_health.quote: $25 copay/visit 30% coinsurance Limited to 180 visits per calendar year.

rehabilitation.quote: $25 copay/visit outpatient; $50 copay per day / $250 copay per admission for inpatient 30% coinsurance for outpatient; 40% coinsurance for inpatient Calendar year maximum of 30 days for inpatient and 60 sessions for outpatient rehabilitation except as required for mental health parity. May be eligible for 60 days for inpatient and 60 sessions for outpatient rehabilitation for acute head or spinal cord injury.

habilitation.quote: $25 copay/visit outpatient; $50 copay per day / $250 copay per admission for inpatient 30% coinsurance for outpatient; 40% coinsurance for inpatient Calendar year maximum of 30 days for inpatient and 60 sessions for outpatient rehabilitation except as required for mental health parity. May be eligible for 60 days for inpatient and 60 sessions for outpatient rehabilitation for acute head or spinal cord injury. Habilitation services are limited to services that qualify under rehabilitation guidelines and medically necessary to treat a mental health condition. Preauthorization may be required. Failure to obtain preauthorization results in denial.

skilled_nursing.quote: $50 copay per day / $250 copay per admission for inpatient 40% coinsurance Limited to 180 days per calendar year.

durable_medical_equipment.quote: 15% coinsurance 30% coinsurance Includes supplies and prosthetics. Frequency limits apply to some durable medical equipment (DME). Preauthorization may be required. Failure to obtain preauthorization results in denial.
